scripts.build: rimraf lib && cross-env DATABASE_URL="postgres://localhost:5432/postgres" prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && tsc
scripts.dev:emul: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first dotenv -e .env.local -- dotenv -e prisma/.env -- firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.prisma:gen: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first dotenv -e prisma/.env -- prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first dotenv -e prisma/.env -- prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:setup: npm run prisma:gen && npm run prisma:push
